list.name: perWorker
list.query: Aggregated : model_name,Per Worker : model_name\, engine\, worker_rank

title: vLLM - UCM Layerwise (vLLM Metrics)
description: UCM observability dashboard - layerwise module. Part of a set; the other UCM dashboards (tag: ucm-vllm-connector-metrics) are linked from the header.

panels.description: Per-second rate of layerwise batches split by whether the batch had load work, save work, or both. Use this before comparing averages across batch categories.
panels.title: Layerwise / Batch Mix Rate

panels.description: Total batch duration for batches with load work and no save work. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg by engine and worker_rank.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_total_load_only_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_total_load_only_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Stacked average batch duration for load-only batches. Load wait is the batch-level sum of wait_for_layer_load() blocking; other is the remaining batch time.

clamp_min((sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_total_load_only_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_total_load_only_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))) - (sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_load_wait_total_load_only_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_batch_load_wait_total_load_only_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))), 0)

panels.title: Layerwise / Load + Save Batch Avg Breakdown

panels.description: Time wait_for_layer_load() actually blocks while waiting for the current layer load tasks to finish. Near 0 means the forward pass successfully hid load latency; large values mean layerwise loading is visible on the critical path. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg by engine and worker_rank.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_wait_blocking_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_wait_blocking_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Layerwise / wait_for_layer_load Blocking

panels.description: Time from the previous wait_for_layer_load() return to the current wait_for_layer_load() entry. This approximates the forward/save window available to hide the next asynchronous load. Compare it with wait_for_layer_load blocking time. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg by engine and worker_rank.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_inter_wait_interval_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_inter_wait_interval_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Layerwise / wait_for_layer_load Inter-Call Interval

panels.description: Time get_finished(), preemption flush, or the layerwise polling path actually blocks while waiting for async dump completion. Uses the same metric as the connector dump completion wait panel.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:save_completion_wait_duration_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:save_completion_wait_duration_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Layerwise / Dump Completion Wait Duration

panels.description: Time spent in start_load_kv() submitting first-layer asynchronous load tasks. This is a submit-path diagnostic, not storage or transfer latency; high values indicate many requests/blocks, synchronous submit overhead, or submit-side contention. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg by engine and worker_rank.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_first_layer_submit_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_first_layer_submit_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Layerwise / start_load_kv First Layer Submit

panels.description: Time spent in wait_for_layer_load() submitting the next layer asynchronous load tasks after the current layer wait. This is a submit-path diagnostic, not storage or transfer latency, and should normally stay small. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg by engine and worker_rank.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_next_layer_submit_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:layerwise_next_layer_submit_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job=~"$job", engine=~"$engine", worker_rank=~"$worker_rank"}[$__rate_interval]))
